'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
****The [[Israel Defence Forces]] return the remains of 45 [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[Palestinian prisoners in Israeli custody|prisoners]] in exchange for [[Hamas]] returning the remains of three hostages yesterday. [https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2025/nov/3/israel-hands-remains-45-palestinians-hamas-returns-bodies-3-soldiers/ (''The Washington Times'')]
**[[Israeli settler violence]]
***Two [[Palestinian]] teenagers are killed in separate attacks by [[Israeli settlers]] in [[Hebron]] and [[Beit Furik]] respectively, in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.jordannews.jo/Section-20/Middle-East/Palestinian-Killed-by-Settler-Gunfire-in-Hebron-Israeli-Forces-Detain-His-Body-46221 (Jordan News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]], [[Famine in Sudan (2024–present)|Famine in Sudan]]
**The [[Integrated Food Security Phase Classification]] review committee reports that [[famine]] is detected in two [[Sudan]]ese regions, [[Darfur Region|Darfur]] and [[South Kordofan]], amid increased fighting between the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and the [[Rapid Support Forces]], which blocks [[humanitarian access]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/03/g-s1-96318/famine-spreads-to-two-more-areas-in-sudan-global-hunger-authority-says (NPR)]
**At least 40 people are killed and dozens of others are injured in a [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] on a funeral in [[North Kordofan]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/at-least-40-civilians-killed-in-rsf-drone-attack-in-sudan-s-north-kordofan/3734178 (AA)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 BBC editorial bias allegations]]
**''[[The Daily Telegraph]]'' publishes an internal memo leaked by [[Michael Prescott (journalist)|Michael Prescott]] alleging [[media bias]] in the [[BBC]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2025/11/03/bbc-report-reveals-bias-donald-trump/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')] [https://inews.co.uk/news/bbc-accused-of-misleading-viewers-with-trump-capitol-clip-4019402 (''The i Paper'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The 2025 [[Miguel de Cervantes Prize]] is awarded to [[Mexican literature|Mexican writer]] [[Gonzalo Celorio]]. [https://www.euronews.com/culture/2025/11/04/celebrating-a-lifetime-of-literature-gonzalo-celorio-wins-spains-coveted-cervantes-prize-2 (Euronews)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Balkh earthquake]]
**A {{M|w|6.3}} earthquake strikes near [[Mazar-i-Sharif]], [[Balkh Province|Balkh]], [[Afghanistan]], killing at least 20 people, injuring hundreds others, and damaging the historic [[Mausoleum of Imam Ali|Blue Mosque]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/magnitude-63-earthquake-hits-afghanistans-hindu-kush-region-usgs-says-2025-11-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistans-historic-blue-mosque-damaged-by-earthquake/a-74603321 (DW)]
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least two people are killed and tens of thousands are displaced as [[Typhoon Kalmaegi]] makes [[landfall]] in [[Central Visayas]], [[Philippines]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/typhoon-leaves-2-dead-traps-people-roofs-submerges-127158095 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[2025 Nepal snowstorm disaster]]
**Seven people are killed and eight injured when an [[avalanche]] strikes a [[base camp]] on a mountain in [[Nepal]]. [https://www.freepressjournal.in/world/7-killed-4-missing-as-avalanche-strikes-nepals-yalung-ri-base-camp (''The Free Press Journal'')] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment/article/avalanche-on-nepal-mountain-yalung-ri-kills-7-including-foreign-climbers/ (CTV News)]
*[[2025 Shap derailment]]
**A landslide causes a [[West Coast Main Line]] passenger train to derail near [[Shap]], [[Cumbria]], [[United Kingdom]], injuring four people. [https://news.sky.com/story/paramedics-sent-to-train-derailment-in-cumbria-as-rail-services-affected-13463052 (Sky News)] [https://newsdesk.avantiwestcoast.co.uk/news/avanti-west-coast-statement-about-train-derailment-at-shap-cumbria (Avanti West Coast)]
*At least 20 people are killed and several others are injured when a truck collides with a bus in [[Ranga Reddy district]], [[Telangana]], [[India]]. [https://www.indiatvnews.com/telangana/hyderabad-telangana-accident-15-dead-injured-in-road-accident-chevella-2025-11-03-1015568 (India TV)]
*At least 19 people are killed and 40 people are injured when a speeding dump truck collides with 17 vehicles in [[Jaipur]], [[Rajasthan]], India. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/10-killed-40-injured-as-dumper-truck-driver-rams-vehicles-in-drunken-rampage-in-jaipur-2812619-2025-11-03 (''India Today'')]
*At least 15 people, mostly children, are missing and presumed dead after floods and landslides strike [[Highland Papua]], [[Indonesia]], following heavy rainfall. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/fifteen-people-mostly-children-missing-after-floods-indonesias-papua-official-2025-11-03/ (Reuters)]
*A part of the [[Torre dei Conti]] tower collapses in [[Rome]], [[Italy]], killing a worker and critically injuring another. [https://www.reuters.com/world/workers-injured-partial-collapse-tower-near-romes-colosseum-2025-11-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Demographics of Papua New Guinea]]
**The results of the 2024 [[census]] in [[Papua New Guinea]] show that the country has surpassed the line of 10 million inhabitants, significantly below the 2023 UN estimate of 11.8 million. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/577772/papua-new-guinea-s-population-surpasses-10-million-census-data-reveals (RNZ)]

'''International relations'''
*[[10th Summit of the Americas]]
**The [[Dominican Republic]] postpones the [[Summit of the Americas]] until next year, citing regional tensions following [[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers|U.S. military operations]] near [[Venezuela]] and [[2025 Atlantic hurricane season|storm damage]] in several participating countries. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2025/11/04/americas-summit-postponed-amid-tension-over-us-military-deployment (AFP via ''FMT'')]
*[[Mexico–Peru relations]]
**[[Peru]] announces it has severed diplomatic relations with [[Mexico]], citing Mexico's decision to grant [[Asylum seeker|asylum]] to former [[Prime Minister of Peru|Peruvian prime minister]] [[Betssy Chávez]], as well as alleged interference in [[Politics of Peru|Peru's internal political affairs]] following [[President of Peru|President]] [[Pedro Castillo]]'s [[2022 Peruvian self-coup attempt|2022 self-coup]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/peru-breaks-diplomatic-relations-with-mexico/a-74604428 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Mexico|Mexican]] [[Mexican Armed Forces|security forces]] kill 13 suspected [[Sinaloa Cartel|gunmen]] and arrest four others in [[Guasave]], [[Sinaloa]], during an armed confrontation that also leads to the rescue of nine kidnapped individuals. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-authorities-kill-13-face-off-cartel-plagued-state-2025-11-04/ (Reuters)] [https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2025/11/03/reportan-enfrentamiento-armado-y-operativo-en-guasave-sinaloa/ (Infobae)]
*[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
**A commercial [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] is attacked by suspected Somali [[pirates]] off the coast of [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/assailants-attack-tanker-off-somalia-suspected-pirate-strike-2025-11-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Spanish floods]]
**[[Carlos Mazón]] resigns as [[President of the Valencian Government|President]] of the [[Valencian Community|Valencia]]n [[Generalitat Valenciana|government]] following sustained criticism of his government's response to the floods in the region last year. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/nov/03/valencia-president-carlos-mazon-resigns-deadly-floods-spain (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.eldiario.es/comunitat-valenciana/mazon-anuncia-dimision-diferido-presidente-generalitat-cerrar-sucesor-valide-vox_1_12133992.html (''elDiario.es'')]
*[[2025 Guinean presidential election]]
**Incumbent [[Guinea]]n [[List of presidents of Guinea|president]] [[Mamady Doumbouya]] submits his candidacy for the election. The election is being held under a new [[Constitution of Guinea|constitution]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly10e87d08o (BBC News)]
*[[2025 Tanzanian general election]]
**Incumbent [[Tanzania]]n [[President of Tanzania|president]] [[Samia Suluhu Hassan]] is sworn in for a second term in office after winning a disputed election last Wednesday, which sparked [[2025 Tanzanian election protests|deadly protests]] across the country. [https://apnews.com/article/tanzania-election-samia-suluhu-hassan-44d070fe41edae4bc8bd9e2c19e7e992 (AP)]
